    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Course
    A course, which is composed of a course name, offerings and enrollment.
    Course.EnrollmentPoint
     
    Course.EnrollmentProjection
    Calculates the enrollment expected on the add-deadline date of the current semester, based on how a course's enrollment grew between the equivalent snapshot date and its add deadline in a past semester.
    DetailedReport
    Our Detailed Projection Report; given data and creates report file.
    EnrollmentSnapshot
    EnrollmentSnapshot; a capture of Course registration data, taken from a particular snapshot.
    main
    Main class of our program.
    Offering
    Offering; an offering of a course.
    ProjectionReader
    ProjectionReader; Reads semester directories and creates the proper nesting of Semesters - Snapshots - Courses - Offerings - Sections.
    Section
    A course Section.
    Semester
    A Semester; for our purposes it is composed of a title, code, pre-registration and add-deadline dates, as well as several snapshots of enrollment relevent to the semester.
    SummaryReport
    SummaryReport; terminal output to summarize our projection.
    SummaryReport.CourseProjection
    CourseProjection; all the information relevent to define a course projection.
    TotalCapEnroll
    TotalCapEnroll calculates and formats the total cap enrollment for courses by aggregating the overall caps of their constituent offerings and sections.
